title: Canonical localized transitions between derived tower evaluations
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\mathcal A)$ be its category of inverse sequences [def-weil-inverse-system], and choose the unbounded derived categories of $\mathcal A$ and $\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)$, with their localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $E_n:\operatorname{Tow}(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal A$ for exact evaluation at $n$. For every arrow $t:m\to n$ of $\mathbf N^{op}$, define the actual derived evaluation transition $\delta_t:D(E_m)\Rightarrow D(E_n)$ as the localization through $Q$ of the natural transformation of cochain functors whose component on a complex $K$ of towers is $Q$ applied to the degreewise map $K(t)$. Thus the construction uses the actual tower arrow and the canonical localization factors of the two exact evaluation functors. Identity arrows and all composite arrows are included. Natural-number index $n$ denotes positive level $n+1$.
